title: His Girl Friday
description: A newspaper editor tries to win back his ex-wife and star reporter for one last big story, starring Cary Grant and Rosalind Russell.

title: Abraham Lincoln
description: A biography of the sixteenth U.S. president, directed by D.W. Griffith.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description: A mysterious masked phantom haunts the Paris Opera and becomes obsessed with a young singer.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
description: A landmark German expressionist horror film about a hypnotist and his sleepwalking subject, told through a framed narrative.

title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
description: An early special-effects-driven silent adaptation of Jules Verne's classic undersea adventure novel.

title: The Lost World
description: The first film adaptation of Arthur Conan Doyle's novel about explorers discovering a plateau where dinosaurs still roam.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: An animated adaptation of the classic Jonathan Swift tale of a shipwrecked sailor among the tiny people of Lilliput.

title: Jungle Book
description: A boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle is adopted by a village, based on Rudyard Kipling's stories.

title: McLintock!
description: A John Wayne comedy-western about a wealthy rancher navigating his estranged wife's return and town politics.

title: My Favorite Brunette
description: A baby photographer mistaken for a detective gets tangled up in a real crime, starring Bob Hope and Dorothy Lamour.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: An eccentric millionaire offers five strangers a large reward for surviving one night in a haunted mansion.

title: Suddenly
description: Hired assassins take a family hostage in their home while waiting to carry out a plot against the President, starring Frank Sinatra.

title: The Stranger
description: A war crimes investigator tracks a Nazi fugitive hiding under a false identity in a quiet Connecticut town.

title: Dressed to Kill
description: Sherlock Holmes, played by Basil Rathbone, investigates a case involving coded music boxes.

title: Tarzan's Revenge
description: A jungle adventure entry in the classic Tarzan film series.

title: Charlie Chaplin Festival
description: A compilation of four classic 1917 Chaplin shorts: The Adventurer, The Cure, Easy Street, and The Immigrant.

title: Three Stooges Episodes
description: A compilation of four classic Three Stooges comedy shorts.

title: Sita Sings the Blues
description: An animated retelling of the Indian epic Ramayana interwoven with a modern breakup story, set to 1920s jazz vocals.

title: Utopia
description: The final film Laurel and Hardy made together, about two castaways who found their own nation on a newly emerged island.

title: Killers From Space
description: A scientist is revived by aliens and used as a pawn in their plan to invade Earth.

title: Bloody Pit of Horror
description: A group of models and photographers are captured and tortured by the deranged owner of an old castle.

title: Grave of the Vampire
description: A man tracks down the vampire father who attacked his mother decades earlier.

title: Voyage to the Planet of Prehistoric Women
description: Astronauts crash on Venus and encounter its native inhabitants in this American re-edit of a Soviet science fiction film.
